body.label: Effect
body.html: Create a floating aetheric sigil in a space within 4 units. The next Magecraft Action originating within 2 units of it gains +1 die, then the sigil disappears.

surges.html: Create a small persistent magical object or patch of terrain appropriate to this spell until the start of your next turn.
If this spell directly affects a maintained supernatural effect, suppress one Rank 0 or Rank 1 benefit of that effect until the end of the turn.

rider.title: AETHER THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to give it +1 die if it interacts with another supernatural effect.
